title: PM ↔ Eng sync prep — Console / Dedicated / Private (scratchpad)
body:
Purpose: prep notes for 1:1 with Eng Lead (Diego) — align on immediate console fixes, Dedicated capacity churn, and Private deployment onboarding blockers.

Meeting goals:
- Quick health check on current sprints (2–3 min)
- Clarify root causes for Dedicated capacity regression (INF-5678) and plan next 2 weeks
- Console UX: error surface + rollout checklist for next canary (PR 412)
- Private onboarding: documentation gaps + on-prem packaging timeline
- Agree on action items, owners, and dates

Context / recent signals:
- Dedicated latency SLOs: 95th jumped from 110ms -> 210ms last Tue during a batch of reserved pools. Customers reported burst failures (RED-1234 escalation).
- Console PR 412 fixes a race in route-config caching; QA passed in staging but we saw a small NPE on canary. Need rollout guard.
- Private: first on-prem kit install for beta customer delayed — missing KMS integration docs and example HSM config. Seemed like devs assumed cloud KMS.

Key questions to ask Diego:
1) Dedicated regression: do we have a dominant hypothesis (kernel scheduling vs autoscaler misconfig)? any telemetry dashboards I should check?
2) Can we carve a short rollback/fallback plan if PR 412 introduces NPE in more canaries? Is feature-flagging granular enough?
3) Private onboarding: who owns the KMS/HSM docs (platform eng vs security)? ETA for a minimal example (30-min setup) we can give to beta customer?
4) Capacity for Dedicated: any levers we can expose to sales (burst credit, queue prioritization) in next release?
5) Are there any cross-team blockers I should surface with Solutions Eng or Support?

Notes to self (things to say):
- Emphasize: short-term mitigation > perfect fix for Dedicated (we need customer breathing room).
- Ask for concrete, testable validation steps for rollback of PR 412.
- Offer to re-prioritize one doc task from my backlog to unblock Private beta (writing KMS quickstart).

Proposed agenda (10–15 min):
- 0:00–0:03 quick sync: how are you? any urgent fires?
- 0:03–0:07 Dedicated regression summary + current evidence
- 0:07–0:11 Console PR 412 rollout plan + guard rails
- 0:11–0:14 Private beta blockers + doc ownership
- 0:14–0:15 Action items + next check-in

Pre-reads to reference (I will paste links in Slack before meeting):
- INF-5678 incident timeline (ops notes)
- RED-1234 customer escalation thread (support thread)
- PR 412 diff and rollout notes
- Draft KMS quickstart (my local branch)

Immediate action item candidates (capture in meeting):
- Diego: allocate SRE time to run replay harness vs busiest pool (due 2026-03-19) — owner string: Diego Rivera
- Maya: finalize KMS quickstart minimal draft and share with security for review (due 2026-03-17) — owner: Maya Chen
- Priya: add a temporary dedicated autoscaler hook to cap burst to safe limit for 2 weeks (due 2026-03-16) — owner: Priya Nair
- Diego + Eng: add canary guard to console rollout pipeline (feature flag, health-check threshold) before merging PR 412 to prod (due 2026-03-15) — owner: Diego Rivera

Follow-ups post-meeting (how I'll run them):
- Create GH issue to track rollback guard items and link PR 412.
- Post a short summary + action items to #eng-product-sync and tag Diego/Priya.
- Update the PrivateDeployments confluence page with a KMS quickstart section and link to the beta customer playbook.
- Re-check INF-5678 telemetry dashboards on 2026-03-17 and note trends.

Risks & Mitigations (talking points):
- Risk: aggressive autoscaler patch might reduce throughput for other tenants. Mitigation: small gradual cap, monitor per-tenant queue depth.
- Risk: rushed KMS quickstart could leak assumptions about cloud and confuse beta. Mitigation: mark as "minimal example" and pair with security review.
- Risk: console NPE could cascade to route-config state. Mitigation: require health-check gating and staged canary (1% -> 20%).

Loose ideas (brainstorm) to discuss if time allows:
- Expose a beta toggle for customers to opt into conservative batching on Dedicated to reduce SLO variance.
- Add a "deploy safety" scorecard on console rollouts with checks (schema migrations, cache invalidation tests).

Stuff to bring to Diego if he asks for data:
- 7-day latency P95 per-pool (grafana panel)
- Recent autoscaler decision logs (logs from 2026-03-08 spike)
- Canaries where PR 412 ran and corresponding error rates

Quick personal notes:
- If Diego is swamped, ask him to triage TODO for SRE allocation and I'll coordinate with Solutions Eng to patch messaging to customers.
- Be explicit about deadlines — time-box fixes to 2 weeks where possible.

End of scratchpad.

(Will copy into Slack and into a confluence draft after the 1:1. Keep this doc as scratch until action items are assigned.)
